Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `b53d7b5a347066148c25f196c97618d477d3723a`

Inputs, and nothing else: card #21973 (body, triage first grade 6012899424, claim 6013846983, dev report 6014842061); PR #21981 (body, file list, the net diff of the head against its merge base with `main`, `f76c6221ac`); the check-runs on the head; objectui at the `.objectui-sha` the head pins (`0abd4f9f87`, unchanged from base), read with `git show` only. Leg: the path leg (`packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts`, a non-test spec source). Four files, +32/-8.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept set — unchanged, judged right.** Inside `ObjectNavItemSchema` the diff touches only the `.describe()` string of `viewName` and adds a docblock above it. `z.string().optional()` stays; no key added, removed or renamed, no type, optionality, default or export change anywhere in the file. The PR's `Clause-②: no` holds.
- **Public surface the diff implies — judged right.** The new describe publishes in `dist/ui` and in the emitted JSON Schema `description` (`json-schema` and `dist` are in `@objectstack/spec` `files[]`, as is `src/**/*.zod.ts`, which carries the docblock). The checked-in `json-schema.manifest/**` is a ratchet of emitted schema names, not descriptions, and `api-surface/**` records exports: neither moves. The one checked-in derived artifact is `content/docs/references/ui/app.mdx`: its five `viewName` rows are byte-equal to the new describe and nothing else in the page moved, which is the shape of a regeneration, not a hand edit; `Type Check · source gates`, the job that runs `check:docs`, `check:generated --reconcile-only` and `check:objectui-pin-citations`, is green on the head. A census of the old sentence over the head tree (releases and CHANGELOGs excluded) leaves one hit, the lint test comment in ③.
- **The describe against objectui at the pin — every clause judged right.**
  - "When omitted, the console opens the object's default list view": `NavigationRenderer.tsx` `resolveHref` reads `recordId`, then `filters`, then `viewName`; with none it emits the bare object path, the `:objectName` route, so `ObjectView` mounts with no `viewId` param, `requestedViewId` is undefined, `resolvedViewId` is undefined, and `activeViewId = resolvedViewId || defaultViewId || views[0]?.id` (ObjectView.tsx:2138–2151). `defaultViewId` (:2129) is the first tab carrying `isDefault`. `buildViewTabs` (:936) sets `isDefault: true` on the primary `list` (`primaryId` from `defaultListViewId`, undefined when the object declares no `list`) and moves it to the front; a saved overlay row's own `isDefault` (a user's set-default) merges over it afterwards. "The object's default list view" covers both.
  - "else its first declared list view": `views[0]` after the memo's sort, which keeps the composed metadata order (`indexOf`) unless a per-user `viewOrder` localStorage entry or a saved row's `sortOrder` exists. That is per-user state layered over the metadata rule, outside what a spec sentence can state; the sentence is the metadata rule triage specified. Right.
  - "`all` names the console's fallback tab, which exists only for an object that declares no list view": `buildViewTabs` pushes `fallbackTab()` (`id: 'all'`) only when `viewList.length === 0` after the primary promotion, that is no `listViews` entry, no `list`, and no top-level list-kind `view` item the composer mirrored in (`MetadataProvider.applyViewItem`, `mergeViewsIntoObjects`). Saved rows merge after that step, so the condition is about declared metadata. Right.
  - "Ignored when `recordId` is set": `resolveHref` returns the record href before it reads `viewName` when the template resolves. Pre-existing clause, kept. Right.
- **The dev's wording "declares no list view" rather than the claim's "declares no `listViews`" — judged right.** An object that declares only a primary `list` has no `listViews` key yet gets no `all` tab (its `list` is promoted and marked default), so the claim's spelling would have stated a condition the code does not apply. The spec's `listViews` describe names them "built-in named list views" beside `list`; "no list view" is the condition `viewList.length === 0` actually expresses.
- **The docblock — judged right, one observation.** It names the bare route, `defaultViewId || views[0]`, the `isDefault` mark and the fallback condition, each as the code has it. Its parenthetical "(the default `list`)" names the one view `buildViewTabs` itself marks; a user set-default on a saved row also carries `isDefault`, which the describe's own words already cover. Comment only; no change asked.
- **The lint header — judged right.** The quote follows the new text, and "an unresolvable name does not fail, it falls back to that same view" is what the code does: `resolveViewId` (`@object-ui/core`, exact id, short name with the prefix added, qualified name with it stripped) returns undefined on a miss, `ObjectView` logs a `console.warn` and takes `defaultViewId || views[0]`, the same expression the omitted case takes. The diff in `lint-view-refs.ts` is the header comment alone: no rule, severity, matcher or test moves.
- **First sentence kept ("Default list view to open.") — judged right.** Still true of the key, and quoted verbatim in the four places the dev lists.
- **No new id — judged right.** The describe text carries no tracker id. The `(#21973)` in the docblock and in the changeset are a code comment and a changeset.
- **Serial file, PR #21976 (#21968) — judged no conflict, measured.** #21976 has merged to `main` as `04e776b39a`. Its `app.zod.ts` hunk is the `AppSchema.defaultAgent` docblock at :1655–:1672; this PR's is :429–:442. Disjoint hunks with no shared context; distinct changeset files; #21976's docs file is `content/docs/ai/actions-as-tools.mdx`, not `app.mdx`. Of everything `main` changed since the merge base `f76c6221ac`, the only path this PR also touches is `app.zod.ts`, which is not an `os-regen` routed path, so a local `git merge-tree` is a plain textual answer here (the one routed path in this PR, `app.mdx`, moved on one side only, so no driver runs). `git merge-tree --write-tree 04e776b39a b53d7b5a34` exits 0 with tree `cf2a0e2f1b`, no conflicted path, and that tree's `app.zod.ts` carries both hunks; the same merge onto the current `main` tip `8a399b2b15` (one further commit, `service-datasource`, touching none of the four files) also exits 0.
